description: 小型回归评测集：用于 CI 门禁与管道自检。**不代表真实检索质量**（见 provenance）。
provenance: 语料为**人工合成**的医学文献条目（题名/摘要为评测而编写，非真实出版内容），因此可以安全地随代码分发、且完全确定性。真实质量的评测请用 scripts/eval_retrieval.py --from-library 在你自己的库上跑（用真实文献与真实嵌入模型）。本数据集的作用是：① 指标与融合逻辑的回归门禁；② 任何改动把检索管道改坏时立刻报警。已知偏差：合成语料规模小（40 条）、词面重叠偏高，指标绝对值没有意义，只看**相对变化**。

corpus.title: Accelerated repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for post-stroke depression: a randomized controlled trial
corpus.abstract: We randomized 120 patients with post-stroke depression to accelerated rTMS (five sessions daily for five days) or conventional rTMS. The primary outcome was change in Hamilton Depression Rating Scale score at four weeks. Accelerated rTMS reduced HAMD scores more than conventional treatment.

corpus.title: Theta burst stimulation versus high-frequency rTMS for treatment-resistant depression: a systematic review and meta-analysis
corpus.abstract: This meta-analysis compared intermittent theta burst stimulation with high-frequency rTMS in treatment-resistant depression. Both modalities showed comparable efficacy, with similar dropout rates.

corpus.title: Safety of accelerated transcranial magnetic stimulation: adverse event profile across 5000 sessions
corpus.abstract: We report adverse events across 5000 accelerated TMS sessions. Headache and scalp discomfort were most common; seizure incidence was low.

corpus.title: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for post-stroke cognitive impairment: a randomized trial
corpus.abstract: Patients with post-stroke cognitive impairment received rTMS over the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex or sham. Cognitive scores improved in the active group.

corpus.title: Deep transcranial magnetic stimulation with the H1 coil for major depressive disorder
corpus.abstract: Deep TMS using the H1 coil was evaluated in major depressive disorder. Response rates were comparable to conventional rTMS.

corpus.title: Functional connectivity changes after accelerated rTMS in depression: an fMRI study
corpus.abstract: Resting-state fMRI showed increased connectivity between the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex and limbic regions after accelerated rTMS.

corpus.title: Predictors of response to repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation in depression
corpus.abstract: Younger age and shorter illness duration predicted response to rTMS in a cohort of 300 patients.

corpus.title: Maintenance repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for prevention of depressive relapse
corpus.abstract: Maintenance rTMS reduced relapse rates compared with medication alone over twelve months.

corpus.title: Comparison of once-daily and twice-daily rTMS protocols in major depression
corpus.abstract: Twice-daily rTMS achieved faster response than once-daily dosing without increased adverse events.

corpus.title: Transcranial direct current stimulation versus rTMS for depression: a network meta-analysis
corpus.abstract: Network meta-analysis ranked tDCS and rTMS for efficacy in depression; rTMS ranked higher for response.

corpus.title: Effect of rTMS on sleep quality in patients with depression
corpus.abstract: Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index scores improved after rTMS treatment in depressed patients.

corpus.title: Accelerated rTMS and cognitive function in late-life depression
corpus.abstract: Cognitive outcomes were preserved or improved after accelerated rTMS in older adults with depression.

corpus.title: Cost-effectiveness of repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for treatment-resistant depression
corpus.abstract: rTMS was cost-effective compared with continued pharmacotherapy in treatment-resistant depression.

corpus.title: Electroconvulsive therapy versus rTMS for severe depression: a randomized comparison
corpus.abstract: ECT showed superior efficacy in severe depression but higher cognitive side effects than rTMS.

corpus.title: Mechanisms of action of transcranial magnetic stimulation: synaptic plasticity and neurotrophins
corpus.abstract: We review evidence that TMS induces long-term potentiation-like plasticity and modulates BDNF signalling.

corpus.title: Guidelines on the therapeutic use of repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation: an update
corpus.abstract: Updated evidence-based guidelines define indications and stimulation parameters for rTMS across psychiatric and neurological disorders.

corpus.title: Placebo response in repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation trials for depression
corpus.abstract: Sham-controlled trials show substantial placebo response, which may inflate effect sizes.

corpus.title: Nurse-led follow-up after stroke: effects on depression screening and treatment initiation
corpus.abstract: Nurse-led follow-up increased depression screening rates after stroke but did not change treatment initiation.

corpus.title: Antidepressant pharmacotherapy for post-stroke depression: a systematic review
corpus.abstract: SSRIs showed modest benefit for post-stroke depression with increased bleeding risk.

corpus.title: Exercise interventions for post-stroke depression: a meta-analysis
corpus.abstract: Aerobic exercise reduced depressive symptoms after stroke with moderate effect size.
corpus.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

corpus.title: Cognitive behavioural therapy for post-stroke depression: a randomized controlled trial
corpus.abstract: CBT reduced depressive symptoms and improved quality of life at six months.

corpus.title: Inflammation and post-stroke depression: the role of cytokines
corpus.abstract: Elevated interleukin-6 and tumour necrosis factor were associated with post-stroke depression.

corpus.title: Hippocampal volume and treatment response in late-life depression
corpus.abstract: Smaller hippocampal volume predicted poorer response to antidepressant treatment.

corpus.title: Digital cognitive behavioural therapy for depression: a pragmatic trial
corpus.abstract: App-delivered CBT improved symptoms in mild to moderate depression.

corpus.title: Ketamine for treatment-resistant depression: efficacy and safety
corpus.abstract: Intravenous ketamine produced rapid but transient antidepressant effects.

corpus.title: Suicide risk assessment after stroke: a clinical review
corpus.abstract: We summarise instruments for assessing suicide risk in stroke survivors.

corpus.title: Impact of depression on functional recovery after stroke: a cohort study
corpus.abstract: Depressed patients achieved lower functional independence scores at three months.

corpus.title: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation for anxiety disorders: a systematic review
corpus.abstract: rTMS showed promise for generalised anxiety disorder but evidence remains limited.

corpus.title: Transcranial magnetic stimulation in children and adolescents: safety considerations
corpus.abstract: We reviewed safety data for TMS in paediatric populations.
corpus.journal: Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry

corpus.title: Motor cortex stimulation and motor recovery after stroke
corpus.abstract: Stimulation of the motor cortex improved upper limb function after stroke.

corpus.title: Aphasia rehabilitation after stroke: intensity and timing
corpus.abstract: Higher intensity aphasia therapy was associated with better language outcomes.

corpus.title: Dysphagia management after acute stroke: a practical guide
corpus.abstract: We describe screening and management of swallowing dysfunction after stroke.

corpus.title: Caregiver burden in post-stroke depression: a cross-sectional study
corpus.abstract: Caregiver burden correlated with patient depression severity.

corpus.title: Blood biomarkers for diagnosing post-stroke depression: a systematic review
corpus.abstract: No single biomarker showed sufficient diagnostic accuracy.

corpus.title: Telehealth delivery of psychotherapy for depression: a meta-analysis
corpus.abstract: Telehealth psychotherapy was non-inferior to face-to-face delivery.

corpus.title: Occupational therapy for activities of daily living after stroke

corpus.title: Sleep apnoea and depression: bidirectional relationships
corpus.abstract: Obstructive sleep apnoea and depression appear to reinforce each other.

corpus.title: Mindfulness-based stress reduction for chronic disease: an umbrella review
corpus.abstract: Mindfulness interventions showed small to moderate benefits across chronic conditions.

corpus.title: Nutritional interventions for depression: a systematic review of randomized trials
corpus.abstract: Omega-3 supplementation showed small benefits; evidence for other nutrients was weak.

corpus.title: Stigma and help-seeking in post-stroke depression
